postconditions.statement: 工程中已新增或修改与CANN相关的模型部署、转换、推理或AscendC算子代码与配置 / The project has added or modified CANN-related code and configuration for model deployment, conversion, inference, or AscendC operators
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the agent's edit set clearly add or modify source files, build files, scripts, or configs related to CANN model conversion, inference, deployment, or AscendC custom operator development?

postconditions.statement: 实现内容体现了面向Kirin/NPU的执行路径，而非仅调用高层现成AI服务接口 / The implementation reflects an execution path targeting Kirin/NPU rather than merely calling high-level ready-made AI service APIs
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is the solution centered on low-level model/runtime/operator integration for Kirin/NPU rather than just invoking packaged speech, vision, or NLP service APIs?

postconditions.statement: 若涉及模型接入，已补充模型格式转换、输入输出处理或AIPP相关配置之一 / If model integration is involved, at least one of model format conversion, input/output handling, or AIPP-related configuration has been added
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edits integrate a model, do they include evidence of conversion handling, tensor input/output preparation, or AIPP/preprocessing configuration?
